description: JVM nullable slice conformance (ISSUE-0108). Fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → the REAL javac compiler frontend (single-module fixtures in-process via compileWithJavac; whole-project fixtures keep the javac launcher) → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed). Covered forms: T | null for the four primitives and local classes in locals, module fields, class fields, parameters, and returns; null-check branches (narrowing both directions, else-branch narrowing, narrowing invalidation after assignment, narrowed module fields); nullable boundary checks at the table-read untyped boundary (int | null, class | null nominal checks, array | null); nullable arrays T[] | null; arrays of nullable elements (T | null)[] for the primitives and local classes; class arrays C[] and (C | null)[]; the int()/number() nullable conversion overloads with the runtime null failure; and frontend compile-error gates (E3001 nullable-to-non-nullable read, E3001 narrowing invalidation, E3006 int === null) rejected before any backend runs.

tests.name: jvm-nullable-int-locals-flow
tests.description: int | null locals wrap a plain int, hold null, narrow to int in the !== null branch and to null in the === null branch; narrowed arithmetic computes 5+1+1=7

tests.name: jvm-nullable-string-flow
tests.description: string | null narrows to string for concatenation and string equality inside the null-check branch

tests.name: jvm-nullable-boolean-flow
tests.description: boolean | null narrows to boolean in the non-null branch (used as an if condition) and to null in the === null branch

tests.name: jvm-nullable-number-flow
tests.description: number | null flows through a nullable return value, narrows, and feeds number arithmetic

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-flow
tests.description: a local class value wraps into C | null, the null-check branch narrows to C for field reads, and the === null branch holds the null side

tests.name: jvm-nullable-fields
tests.description: required-present nullable fields (int | null, string | null, boolean | null, C | null) default to null, accept writes of values and null, and narrow through locals for reads (1 + 10 + 5 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 23)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-params-returns
tests.description: nullable parameters accept plain values and null; nullable returns carry values and null (0-when returns null, 42 otherwise; want returns 'ok'/null)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-array-local
tests.description: int[] | null holds an array or null; the non-null branch reads, appends via the i === length write, and reads .length; the null side compares === null (1+2+9+4+1=17)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-elements-array
tests.description: (int | null)[] stores null and int elements, reads back null and values with the === null / !== null branches, and reads past the end as the DEAL null (1 + 5 + 1 = 7)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-string-elements-array
tests.description: (string | null)[] literal from homogeneous nullable parameter values, nullable string read, and === null branch on the past-end read

tests.name: jvm-nullable-number-elements-array
tests.description: (number | null)[] writes number and null elements; narrowed reads feed number arithmetic and the int() conversion (5.0 + 1.0 = 6)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-boolean-elements-array
tests.description: (boolean | null)[] stores true and null; the === null read branches and the narrowed boolean feeds an if condition

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-arrays
tests.description: C[] holds local class instances with per-class nominal reads/writes; C[] | null narrows to the array; (C | null)[] stores instances and null and narrows reads (1+1+2+1+1+1=7)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-boundary-success
tests.description: a table read into an int | null contextual target passes a stored int through the nullable boundary check and narrows (41 + 1 = 42)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-boundary-null
tests.description: a table read into an int | null contextual target passes the stored Java-null-equivalent missing entry through as the DEAL null and the === null branch runs

tests.name: jvm-nullable-boundary-failure
tests.description: a table read into an int | null contextual target fails the runtime nullable boundary with E8001 when the stored value is a string (LuaJIT's check_nullable → check_int failure)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-boundary-success
tests.description: a table read into a C | null contextual target runs the nullable nominal check and passes a genuine instance through (x + 1 = 8)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-boundary-failure
tests.description: a table read into a C | null contextual target fails the nullable nominal check with E8001 when the stored value is a plain table (LuaJIT's check_type class branch)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-array-boundary-success
tests.description: a table read into an int[] | null contextual target passes a stored array through the nullable array boundary and narrows to reads (1 + 2 = 3)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-array-boundary-failure
tests.description: a table read into an int[] | null contextual target fails the nullable array boundary with E8001 when the stored value is a table (LuaJIT's check_array failure)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-conversion-intrinsics
tests.description: int(n: int | null) unwraps a present value and number(n: number | null) converts; the results compose (3 + 2 = 5)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-conversion-null-failure
tests.description: int(null-typed int | null) fails at runtime with E8001 'cannot convert null to int' (LuaJIT's int_convert null rejection)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-module-field-narrowing
tests.description: a module-level int | null field narrows inside a function's null-check branch and the doubled value returns (4 * 2 = 8)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-if-else-branches
tests.description: the === null branch narrows to null and the else branch narrows to int; r = 1 on the null side and 0 elsewhere (n starts null)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-null-typed-flow
tests.description: a null-typed local holds a nullable narrowed-to-null read, and null-typed values compare === null inside a nullable branch

tests.name: jvm-nullable-narrowing-invalidation
tests.description: assigning null inside a narrowed block invalidates the narrowing: the follow-up non-null read is a compile-time E3001 rejected before any backend runs

tests.name: jvm-nullable-unwrapped-read-compile-error
tests.description: reading an int | null into an int target without narrowing is a compile-time E3001 rejected before any backend runs
tests.source:
let n: int | null = 1;
let i: int = n;

tests.name: jvm-nullable-null-compare-compile-error
tests.description: comparing a plain int with null is a compile-time E3006 rejected before any backend runs (only T | null compares with null)
tests.source:
let i: int = 1;
let b: boolean = i === null;

tests.name: jvm-nullable-null-assignment-flow
tests.description: a null-typed assignment expression (whose emitted Java code carries the boxed target's type) flows into int | null, string | null, and null targets, and through a nullable parameter (1 + 10 + 100 + 1 = 112)

tests.name: jvm-nullable-array-wrong-wrapper-boundary
tests.description: a string[] stored in a table and read back as int[] | null fails the wrapper gate with E8001 (the JVM storage analog of LuaJIT's check_array element mismatch) — never a raw cast

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-array-wrong-class-boundary
tests.description: an Other[] stored in a table and read back as Item[] | null fails the per-class wrapper gate with E8001 — the nominal array identity never accepts a same-shaped foreign class array

tests.name: jvm-nullable-class-array-boundary-success
tests.description: an Item[] stored in a table and read back as Item[] | null passes the per-class wrapper gate and narrows to reads (x + length = 2)
